business.overview:
Enova International is a technology-driven financial services company providing online lending to non-prime consumers and small businesses. The company uses proprietary AI and machine learning algorithms for credit underwriting, enabling real-time decisioning with superior loss prediction. Yahoo Finance· profile

Enova operates through multiple brands serving the underbanked market — a segment traditional banks have largely abandoned. The company's technology platform processes millions of data points per application, allowing it to profitably serve customers that score poorly on traditional FICO models. The company also operates in Brazil (per 10-K filings and membership in Associacao Brasileira de Credito Digital), though the vast majority of revenue remains U.S.-based. SEC EDGAR 10-K· annual

risks.riskSummary: Profitable fintech with solid credit metrics, but highly leveraged ($4.86B debt vs $5.04B MCap), pending a transformative $350M Grasshopper Bank acquisition (S-4 filed, closing H2 2026) that adds integration and regulatory approval risk. Prior CFPB $15M penalty and non-prime lending exposure compound the profile.

riskCards.title: Credit Cycle Risk
points: Non-prime consumer lending sensitive to recession
Default rates could spike in economic downturn
riskCards.verdict: According to management commentary, AI underwriting has improved loss rates vs traditional models — track record through prior credit cycles provides some confidence

riskCards.title: Regulatory Risk
points: Enova paid a $15M CFPB civil penalty for consumer loan processing errors
CFPB fair lending rule change effective Jul 2026 may alter compliance costs
State-level rate cap legislation possible for non-prime lending
riskCards.verdict: Prior CFPB penalty signals regulatory scrutiny is active, not theoretical; new fair lending rule effective Jul 2026

riskCards.title: M&A / Grasshopper Acquisition
points: $350M stock-and-cash acquisition of Grasshopper Bank (S-4 filed Dec 2025, closing H2 2026)
Enova becomes a bank holding company subject to Fed and OCC regulatory approval
Stock component (~0.038 ENVA shares per Grasshopper share) will dilute existing shareholders
Integration risk: merging digital lending with traditional bank infrastructure
riskCards.verdict: Transformative deal brings $1.4B assets and $3B deposits but regulatory approval and integration execution are not guaranteed

riskCards.title: Leverage & Debt
points: Cash position only $110M — limited buffer if credit conditions deteriorate
Securitization-dependent funding model ($164M + $261M ABS notes issued in 2025)
riskCards.verdict: Near-parity debt-to-equity amplifies downside in a credit cycle downturn; funding model depends on continued ABS market access
